title: The Anti-Boring Meal Prep System | Teriyaki, Sesame Ginger, Fajita Lime & Cilantro Lime Marinades
description:
this is how i meal prep chicken without eating the same meal all week.

prep once. freeze by flavor. thaw and cook fresh when you want it.

marinate (4–12h) before cooking or freezing.

🍗 Marinades (500g chicken each, 2 servings)

FAJITA LIME [362 cal / 49P ]
* 1 tbsp fajita seasoning
* 2 tbsp lime juice
* 1 tbsp EVOO
* 1 tbsp cilantro

SESAME GINGER [385 cal / 52P ]
* 1 tbsp sesame oil
* 1/4c soy sauce
* 1 tbsp ginger
* 1 clove garlic
* 3 green onion

CILANTRO LIME [361 cal / 49P ]
* 1 tbsp EVOO
* 1/4c cilantro
* 1 lime, juice + zest
* 1 garlic clove
* 1/2 tsp cumin
* 1/4 tsp chili
* 1/2 tsp salt
* 1/4 tsp pepper

TERIYAKI [383 cal / 51P ]
* 1 tbsp tamari
* 1 tbsp sesame oil
* 1 tbsp rice vinegar
* 1 green onion
* 2 tsp ginger
* 2 clove garlic
